title: After the Ending
synopsis: The hours right after it ends, when the room is too quiet and you are not ready to be told it gets better. Voices that stay low and sit in the ache with you instead of rushing you out of it — grief, longing, and the slow tidal pull of missing someone who is not coming back.

arcs.label: the fresh wound
arcs.summary: Rawest and closest to the moment it broke — nothing softened yet, the ache still sharp.

arcs.label: the long ache
arcs.summary: The dull, ongoing weight of missing them once the shock wears off; quieter, heavier, endless.

arcs.label: letting it settle
arcs.summary: Not over it, but starting to carry it — the first inch toward acceptance and a held kind of calm.

title: The 3 A.M. Clarity
synopsis: The reflective hour when the noise dies down and you finally think a thought all the way through. Bittersweet, clear-eyed songs about growing up, drifting apart, and the small revelations that only arrive when you are half-awake and honest with yourself for once.

arcs.label: the quiet turn
arcs.summary: The noise fades and the first honest thought arrives, unhurried and a little raw.

arcs.label: what it added up to
arcs.summary: Looking back at what changed, who drifted, and who you quietly became along the way.

arcs.label: making peace
arcs.summary: Reflective and clear-eyed, landing somewhere gentler than where it started.

title: Soft Morning Light
synopsis: The gentle lift of a good morning — warm without shouting about it, hopeful without pretending nothing ever hurt. Easy, kind songs that open the curtains and let a little sun in, the sound of small things quietly turning out okay after a long stretch of them not.

arcs.label: curtains open
arcs.summary: The first warm light easing in; soft, unforced, no rush to be anything yet.

arcs.label: small good things
arcs.summary: Little joys landing one after another — nothing loud, just genuinely nice.

arcs.label: into the day
arcs.summary: Brighter and readier, hopeful and light on its feet, out the door.

title: Held
synopsis: Being wholly wanted by someone. Tender, unhurried love songs — the slow-dance kind, the ones for a first look across a room and a hand you do not want to let go of. Devotion sung close to the mic, all warmth and no distance, the safest place in the room.

arcs.label: the first look
arcs.summary: The catch of breath when it begins — new, bright, a little disbelieving.

arcs.label: close and warm
arcs.summary: Settled devotion sung near the mic; steady, tender, sure of itself.

arcs.label: yours
arcs.summary: All-in and unguarded — the fully-held, nothing-between-us stretch.

title: Windows Down
synopsis: Windows down, foot heavier on the pedal, the world blurring past. Big, propulsive, wide-screen songs built for motion and momentum — the kind that make an empty highway at dusk feel like the finest hour of your own private movie, no destination required.

arcs.label: ignition
arcs.summary: The engine turns over and momentum starts to build; anticipation with a pulse.

arcs.label: open road
arcs.summary: Full speed, wide screen, no brakes — pure forward motion.

arcs.label: the summit
arcs.summary: The soaring, arms-out crest where the whole thing lifts off.

title: Hands in the Air
synopsis: The floor is full and nobody is checking the time. Pure, unbothered euphoria — the hooks everyone already knows by heart, the drops that put every hand in the air, the sound of a night that is going exactly the way you hoped it would when you got ready for it.

arcs.label: doors open
arcs.summary: The night starts to fill up; warm-up energy, grins, first drinks.

arcs.label: peak floor
arcs.summary: Hooks everyone knows, hands up, the room fully committed.

arcs.label: the drop
arcs.summary: Full euphoria, nobody checking the time, the night at its loudest and best.

arcs.label: last-call glow
arcs.summary: Still going on fumes and joy — sweat, singalongs, and no wish to leave.

title: Neon and Shadow
synopsis: After midnight in a city that never fully turns the lights off — sleek, brooding, and a little dangerous. Dark-edged songs with a low pulse and a smirk, the cool-toned corner of the decade where the shadows are not a warning so much as part of the appeal.

arcs.label: after midnight
arcs.summary: Lights low, pulse steady, a little dangerous — the night tipping over.

arcs.label: neon
arcs.summary: Sleek and brooding, cool to the touch, all reflected light and attitude.

arcs.label: the shadow
arcs.summary: The darkest-edged stretch — the smirk in the dark, unbothered and cold.

title: Static and Starlight
synopsis: Almost-silence with a heartbeat under it. Instrumental and ambient pieces to fold the day away to — slow, weightless, and asking nothing of you, made to be half-heard on the long drift down into sleep when words would only get in the way of it.

arcs.label: settling
arcs.summary: The day folds away; the first slow exhale, lights going down.

arcs.label: weightless
arcs.summary: Slow and floating, asking nothing, the mind finally loosening its grip.

arcs.label: under
arcs.summary: The quiet drift all the way down into sleep.
